description: The terms one entry cross-references, its See-also list, each with its abstract. Use it to widen a topic by one step from a term already in hand.

term.description: A term, given either as its key (the lowercase one-word identifier, e.g. 'erm', 'gradientdescent') or as its display name (e.g. 'empirical risk minimization'). Matching is case-insensitive and tolerates small differences in spelling; an input that resembles no published term returns a message saying so rather than a wrong entry.

name: get_related_terms
title: Follow the cross-references
